item.title: Nurani Astra Donates Ambulances, Medical Equipment to Flood-Hit Sumatra
item.description: Jakarta. Nurani Astra, associated with the conglomerate Astra, recently handed over 156 units of medical equipment and 20 ambulances to support post-disaster responses in the flood-hit Sumatra. These assistance had been handed over to the Health Ministry. "Through Nurani Astra, we strive to be present and contribute to helping communities facing post-disaster recovery. item.title: Antam Gold Falls to Rp 3.02M per Gram as Global Prices Slide on Stronger Dollar
item.description: Jakarta. The price of Antam gold bars extended its decline on Friday, falling Rp 21,000 to Rp 3,021,000 per gram, as global bullion prices weakened amid a stronger US dollar and fading expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts. The latest drop follows a sharper fall on Thursday, when Antam gold plunged Rp 45,000 to Rp 3,042,000 per gram. Despite the recent correction, Antam gold prices remain significantly higher this year. item.title: Regional Transfers Reach Rp147.7T by February, Economists Warn of Year-End Spending Rush
item.description: Jakarta. The government has disbursed Rp147.7 trillion ($9.4 billion) in regional transfers as of Feb. 28, up 8.1% from Rp136.6 trillion a year earlier, but economists warn the pace may still lead to a year-end spending rush by local governments. Data from the Finance Ministry show the transfers account for 21.3% of the Rp 693 trillion allocation in the 2026 state budget. item.title: Indonesia Weighs Deficit Above 3% as Oil Risks Mount, Minister Purbaya Says
item.description: Jakarta. Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said the government is still assessing whether Indonesia’s state budget deficit could widen beyond the legal 3% of gross domestic product (GDP), as rising global oil prices and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East pose risks to fiscal stability. item.title: Govt Says 90% of Eid Homecoming Infrastructure Ready Ahead of Travel Surge
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesia’s public works infrastructure is more than 90% ready ahead of the 2026 Eid al-Fitr homecoming exodus, although several repairs are still underway in parts of Sumatra and along the Jakarta–Merak toll road, Public Works Minister Dody Hanggodo said. item.title: Indo Raya Tenaga Embraces Chandra Asri’s CIRCLO© Plastic Asphalt Mixture
item.description: Jakarta. Chandra Asri Group said Friday that its recycled plastic product CIRCLO© had been supporting the road construction of power plant operator Indo Raya Tenaga's operational area. item.description: Jakarta.
